Ascension1.name: Sahril's Madness
Ascension1.description: Enemies receive 30% Increased Threat from Damage Dealers and Healers.

Ascension2.name: Elheryn's Exile
Ascension2.description: Enemy's Interruptable abilities and Dispellable effects deal 20% more damage.

Ascension6.name: Pathfinder's Guidance
Ascension6.description: Elheryn, the Pathfinder, guides you through the dungeon.

BloodShardVolley.name: Blood Shards
BloodShardVolley.description: Blood Shards erupt from dying enemies, dealing 0.7% of their maximum health in damage to all heroes.

MeteorRain.name: Meteor Rain
MeteorRain.description: Periodically, burning meteors crash down on heroes, splitting up into fragments that damage and stun on impact.

ColdSnap.name: Binding Ice
ColdSnap.description: Periodically, one hero is afflicted by an icy curse. After 5 seconds the curse erupts, dealing magic damage to all heroes within the radius and rooting them for 3 seconds.

MalevolentSpirits.name: Malevolent Shade
MalevolentSpirits.description: As heroes kill enemies, eventually a Malevolent Shade will appear, reducing all damage taken by other nearby enemies by 50% and increasing their Haste by 20% until the shade is killed.

StoneSkin.name: Stone Skin
StoneSkin.description: Non-boss enemies have 30% increased Maximum Health

Carnage.name: Carnage
Carnage.description: All incoming damage applies a bleed for 6% of damage taken on all heroes divided evenly. When a hero's health is above 90% the Carnage bleed is removed.

Challenge.name: Challenge
Challenge.description: Non-boss enemies deal 10% more damage and have 10% more health.

Ultimatum.name: Ultimatum
Ultimatum.description: Bosses deal 5% more damage and have 10% more health.

WinterTrickster.name: Krumbug the Naughty
WinterTrickster.description: Krumbug the Naughty is waiting for you somewhere in the dungeon. If you challenge him in combat and defeat him, you will gain access to his bag of tricks.

AnomalousOrbs.name: Anomalous Orbs
AnomalousOrbs.description: Three Anomalous Orbs spawn near enemies periodically. The orbs are targetable and can be damaged.

StormShield.name: Storm Shield
StormShield.description: Periodically, players will charge up with red lightning for 8 seconds, after which a massive bolt strikes all players, dealing lethal damage.

Truesight.name: Truesight
Truesight.description: Every 30% of Kill Score, an enemy will drop a Truesight Orb. Collecting a Truesight Orb will grant Truesight, revealing the next enemy marked by the Heskyr. This enemy will deal pulsating damage until killed.
